facts.business: Sapphire Foods India Limited operates KFC restaurants in India and Sri Lanka as a franchisee of Yum Brands.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Balance between rapid expansion and maintenance of restaurant margin
guidance_or_targets.value: 73 stores added in FY26 (calibrated slightly lower than previous year)

auditor.name: Alwyn Jay & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matter: Impairment assessment of Goodwill (Rs. 1,019.86 million) pertaining to KFC brand CGU; prior year audited by another auditor who expressed unmodified opinion

key_risks: Negative same-store sales growth (SSSG) due to soft consumer demand
Exceptional costs from labour code changes and merger-related expenses
Goodwill impairment risk (Rs. 1,019.86 million) due to judgment in valuation assumptions
Proposed merger with Devyani International Limited creating governance uncertainty
facts.related_party_note: Merger-related expenses with Devyani International Limited; directors may not continue on Board post-merger
